highestRiskCases: a product branch attempts to write program/tracker and self-authorize
a promotion PR attempts to change anything beyond its exact authority-only four-path map
a COMMENTED review uses a stale head or spoofed owner identity
foreign main advance is mistaken for the intended squash merge

closeout accidentally restores runtime or promotes a successor
